searchText: Reminder! No CL call tomorrow. See yall in the new year! We actually can do this. We have a version of the deposit contract that is actually layered with an erc20 token. CL clients can read and use it exactly as a normal dep contract https://gist.github.com/protolambda/307e938dc9e40cbfe7edd78600562682 Also, you can seed the beacon chain with a beacon state that is populated with validators that are not in the dep contract and then use the dep contract from there (A surprise to <@361447803194441738> 😅) This is also a good option for testnets we want to run more like "clique" nets are run. Essentially can just do access control for those entities we want running nodes
